name: S6 Overload Mixed CRUD Probe
description: Open-model overload scenario. Uses the same mixed CRUD profile as S3 (keyset-paginated reads, get-by-id, create, patch) but is driven by a fixed request arrival rate (req/s) instead of a fixed number of clients. Pairs with closed-model S3 to compare mixed-workload plateau (closed) versus the offered rate at which latency, error_rate, and dropped_iteration_rate reveal the breaking point (open).
